title: Kingster University Reaches Historic $420M Research Funding Milestone
excerpt: For the first time in its 100-year history, Kingster University's annual research funding has surpassed $420 million, driven by federal grants, private partnerships, and alumni donations.
author: Office of Research

title: KU Artificial Intelligence Lab Expands to New 10,000 sq ft Facility
excerpt: The KU AI Lab has officially opened its expanded research facility on the Engineering Tower's 8th–10th floors, featuring 5,000+ GPU computing infrastructure and dedicated spaces for interdisciplinary collaboration.
author: Communications Office

title: Prof. Elena Vasquez Featured on Cover of Nature Biotechnology
excerpt: Professor Elena Vasquez and her team at the Center for Genomic Medicine received international recognition as their groundbreaking mRNA delivery research was featured on the cover of Nature Biotechnology.
author: Academic Affairs

title: Spring 2025 Commencement Ceremony to Welcome 4,200 Graduates
excerpt: Kingster University's Spring 2025 Commencement will be held on May 18th at the KU Arena. This year's class includes graduates from 92 countries across 140 academic programs.
author: Registrar's Office

title: KU Secures Four DARPA Contracts for AI Ethics Research
excerpt: The Department of Computer Science has secured four concurrent DARPA contracts totaling $24M to develop governance frameworks for autonomous systems deployed in public infrastructure.
author: Research Communications

title: New Student Wellness Center Opens on North Campus
excerpt: Kingster University has opened a state-of-the-art $18M Student Wellness Center on North Campus, offering mental health services, fitness facilities, and holistic wellbeing programs for all enrolled students.
author: Student Affairs

title: KU Climate Lab Receives EPA Center of Excellence Designation
excerpt: The Climate Science Research Center led by Prof. Amara Diallo has received the prestigious EPA Center of Excellence designation, unlocking $22M in multi-year environmental research funding.
author: Environmental Science Dept.

title: Kingster Rises to #14 in National University Rankings
excerpt: The 2025 QS World University Rankings have placed Kingster University at #14 nationally and #38 globally, a five-position improvement from last year driven by research output and faculty citations.
author: Communications Office

title: Record 6,200 International Students Enroll for Fall 2024
excerpt: Kingster University welcomed a record 6,200 international students from 94 countries in Fall 2024, representing a 12% increase over the previous year and reflecting the university's growing global reputation.
author: Admissions Office
